meta.name: customer-success-management
meta.description: Runs the ongoing relationship with accounts after the sale — segmenting coverage against account value, building a health score that predicts rather than describes, running reviews customers find worth attending, forecasting renewals honestly, and finding expansion that follows usage instead of quota. Use this to design a customer success motion, decide who gets a named contact, work out why renewals surprise you, or fix a health score everyone ignores.

copy.tagline: 设计客户成功机制，预测续约并发现增购机会
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你负责客户成功，想让续约不再意外、健康评分真正有用。
copy.tagline_en: Design a customer success strategy to forecast renewals and find expansion.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you lead customer success and need honest renewal forecasts and credible health scores.

howto.what: 装了这个技能后，Claude会帮你管理卖完产品后的客户关系：按客户重要性分配服务投入，建立能预判流失的健康分，开客户愿意参加的复盘会，诚实预估续约，并按实际使用情况找增购机会。
howto.when: 当你想规划客户成功方案、决定客户覆盖层级或弄清续订意外时触发；修复健康评分等也可用。

say.text: 帮我设计一套客户成功策略，覆盖高价值和普通客户。
say.note: Claude会按价值分层提出覆盖方案。

say.text: 怎么判断哪些客户需要专属客户经理？
say.note: 根据账户复杂度和收入判断。

say.text: 怎样开客户复盘会才不浪费时间？
say.note: Claude会给出以客户目标为主的复盘框架。

howto.what_en: This skill helps Claude manage post-sale accounts: allocate service by account value, build a health score that predicts churn, run reviews customers attend, forecast renewals honestly, and find expansion from real usage.
howto.when_en: Use when planning a customer success motion, deciding coverage levels, or investigating renewal surprises. Also for fixing health scores.

say_en.text: Design a customer success strategy covering high-value and regular accounts.
How do I know which accounts need a dedicated manager?
How can I run reviews customers find worthwhile?
